newsitem.title: USA: Sun Hydraulics sees margin squeeze in Q3.
newsitem.headline: Sun Hydraulics sees margin squeeze in Q3.

text.p: Sun Hydraulics Corp said Monday that it expects to see margins adversely impacted in the third quarter as a result of costs associated with expediting its backlog of customer orders.

In a statement accompanying the release of second quarter earnings, released today, Clyde Nixon, Sun Hydraulics president, said " We expect to address our backlog in the third quarter and anticipate higher than planned shipments. The incremental costs associated with expediting orders to meet customer requirements have negatively impacted our gross margins as a percent of sales, an effect that will continue into the third quarter."
The company reported per-share earnings for the second quarter, ended June 30, of $0.17 per share, versus $0.15 per share, on a proforma basis.
Sun makes high performance screw-in hydraulic cartridge valves and manifolds for global mobile and industrial markets.
